name: Filikod
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Filikod is a lightweight and modern WordPress plugin designed to automate essential media tasks.
It helps you keep your website fast, accessible, and SEO-friendly by handling:

  • ALT text generation based on filenames
  • Removal of title attributes and special characters
  • Automatic image resizing on upload
  • Bulk processing for existing images
  • Secure SVG sanitization
  • Optional support for extended file types

Filikod is not a compression engine.
It focuses on automation, clean metadata, and appropriate image dimensions, keeping performance high without complex configuration.

The plugin works with all themes and page builders (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery…) and requires zero coding knowledge.

Learn more at https://filikod.com/

Features

🔧 Image Resizing (Upload & Bulk)

  • Resize images on upload based on a maximum width you define
  • Maintain aspect ratios automatically
  • Replace originals to save disk space (optional)
  • Bulk resize all existing images from the dashboard

📝 ALT Text Automation

  • Generate ALT text from filenames for images missing ALT attributes
  • Clean special characters for better readability and SEO
  • Automatically remove redundant title attributes for accessibility

🔒 Secure SVG Upload

  • Validate MIME type and file extension
  • Sanitize XML content to remove unsafe elements
  • Block harmful tags like <script>, <iframe>, etc.

📁 Extended File Type Support

Enable additional formats in one click:
– SVGZ, PSD, AI, EPS, ICO
– ZIP, RAR, 7Z
– WEBM (video)

All file types are toggle-based and include warning indicators where necessary.

📊 Clean & Modern Admin Dashboard

  • Total images, ALT coverage, and media statistics
  • Resized image ratio (not compression results)
  • Visual cards and progress indicators
  • Fully responsive interface
  • Works in single-site and multisite environments

Filikod focuses on clarity and automation — install it and let it handle repetitive tasks for you.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Compatible with all themes and page builders
  • Works with GD and Imagick
  • Multisite compatible

Learn more about compatibility at https://filikod.com/.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Filikod through the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Go to Filikod → Settings.
  3. Enable image resizing, ALT tools, SVG support, or file types as needed.

New uploads will be processed automatically.
Use the bulk tools to clean or resize existing images.
sections.faq:
Does Filikod compress images?

No. Filikod resizes images based on the maximum width you define, but it does not perform compression or convert images to WebP/AVIF in this version.

Does Filikod overwrite original images?

If resizing is enabled, the resized image replaces the original to save storage space.

Can I use Filikod with Elementor, Divi or WooCommerce?

Yes, Filikod works with all major builders and plugins.

Can I optimize existing images?

Yes — use the bulk processing button in the dashboard.

Does Filikod support WebP or AVIF?

These features are planned for a future premium release.

Where can I get help?

Documentation and support: https://filikod.com/
